patch.summary: Is LinkedIn Sales Navigator worth it? LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for finding buyers on LinkedIn’s professional network with advanced search, Buyer Intent, InMail, Account/Lead IQ, and Advanced Plus CRM sync.. Strong when Sellers who prospect primarily on LinkedIn’s network and relationship graph. Weak when Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info.

Counter-signal: Drop when Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info outweighs Core value.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics 365, Oracle Cx.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Core, Advanced, Advanced Plus.

sections.heading: Who LinkedIn Sales Navigator is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose LinkedIn Sales Navigator when relationship and LinkedIn-graph prospecting is the primary job — especially if you will also run a separate contact-data tool for emails/dials..

Avoid if: Compare Apollo or Lusha when email/phone data is the bottleneck; ZoomInfo when enterprise enrichment + intent depth is required; Cognism for EMEA phone-verified mobiles..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Apollo.io on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: LinkedIn Sales Navigator price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / network coverage vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
